_comment: OpenCode V2 does NOT read hooks/hooks.json. This file is documentation only — it mirrors the original Claude Code hooks.json for reference. The OpenCode port lives in opencode/plugins/hooks.js as a single V2 plugin using ctx.tool.hook() and ctx.session.hook() APIs.

_mapping.SessionStart: setup(ctx) runs once when the plugin loads
_mapping.SessionEnd: event stream session.end / cleanup return from setup()

_openCode_plugin_register: Copy to ~/.opencode/plugins/hooks.js for auto-load, or add to plugins[] in opencode.json
